MATCH (o:Organism) WHERE o.preferred_name IN ['Prochlorococcus MED4','Prochlorococcus MIT9515','Prochlorococcus SB','Prochlorococcus MIT1327','Prochlorococcus MIT9313','Prochlorococcus PAC1']
OPTIONAL MATCH (o)<-[:Belongs_to_organism|In_organism|Encoded_by*1..2]-(g:Gene)
WITH o, count(DISTINCT g) AS genes
RETURN o.preferred_name AS organism, o.experiment_count AS exp_count, genes
ORDER BY organism

MATCH (g:Gene)-[:Gene_belongs_to_organism]->(o:OrganismTaxon)
WHERE o.genus = 'Prochlorococcus'
OPTIONAL MATCH (g)-[:Gene_has_cyanorak_role]->(r:CyanorakRole {id:'cyanorak.role:D.1.5'})
WITH o, count(DISTINCT g) AS total_genes,
     count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r IS NOT NULL THEN g END) AS p_role_genes
RETURN o.organism_name AS organism, o.clade AS clade, o.experiment_count AS exp, total_genes, p_role_genes
ORDER BY clade, organism

MATCH (g:Gene)-[:Gene_belongs_to_organism]->(o:OrganismTaxon)
WHERE o.genus = 'Prochlorococcus'
OPTIONAL MATCH (g)-[:Gene_has_cyanorak_role]->(r:CyanorakRole)
OPTIONAL MATCH (g)-[:Gene_in_ortholog_group]->(og:OrthologGroup {source:'cyanorak'})
WITH o, count(DISTINCT g) AS total_genes,
     count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r IS NOT NULL THEN g END) AS genes_with_any_cyanorak_role,
     count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN og IS NOT NULL THEN g END) AS genes_in_cyanorak_og
RETURN o.organism_name AS organism, o.clade AS clade, o.experiment_count AS exp,
       total_genes, genes_with_any_cyanorak_role, genes_in_cyanorak_og
ORDER BY genes_with_any_cyanorak_role, organism

MATCH (e:Experiment)-[r:Changes_expression_of]->(g:Gene)
WHERE e.id IN ['10.1038/ismej.2016.70_coculture_prochlorococcus_mit9313_hot1a3_rnaseq','10.1038/ismej.2016.82_coculture_24_hours_after_coculturing_mit1002_rnaseq']
RETURN e.id AS exp,
       r.significant AS significant,
       r.expression_direction AS direction,
       r.expression_status AS status,
       CASE WHEN r.log2_fold_change IS NULL THEN 'null'
            WHEN r.log2_fold_change > 0 THEN 'pos'
            WHEN r.log2_fold_change < 0 THEN 'neg'
            ELSE 'zero' END AS l2fc_sign,
       count(*) AS n
ORDER BY exp, significant, direction, l2fc_sign

MATCH (o:OrganismTaxon)<-[:Gene_belongs_to_organism]-(g:Gene)<-[r:Changes_expression_of]-(e:Experiment)
WHERE o.organism_name CONTAINS 'Alteromonas'
WITH e.id AS exp, e.omics_type AS omics, e.table_scope AS scope,
     sum(CASE WHEN r.log2_fold_change < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS neg,
     sum(CASE WHEN r.log2_fold_change > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pos,
     sum(CASE WHEN r.log2_fold_change IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nullfc,
     count(*) AS total
RETURN exp, omics, scope, neg, pos, nullfc, total,
       toInteger(100.0*neg/total) AS pct_neg
ORDER BY pct_neg, exp

MATCH (e:Experiment)-[r:Changes_expression_of]->(g:Gene)
WHERE e.organism_name CONTAINS 'Alteromonas'
WITH e.id AS exp, e.omics_type AS omics, e.table_scope AS scope,
     e.significant_up_count AS rollup_up, e.significant_down_count AS rollup_down,
     sum(CASE WHEN r.log2_fold_change < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS neg,
     sum(CASE WHEN r.log2_fold_change > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pos,
     count(*) AS total
RETURN exp, omics, scope, rollup_up, rollup_down, neg, pos, total,
       toInteger(100.0*neg/total) AS pct_neg
ORDER BY pct_neg, exp

MATCH (e:Experiment)
WHERE e.id IN [
  '10.1038/ismej.2016.70_coculture_prochlorococcus_mit9313_high_alteromonas_hot1a3_rnaseq',
  '10.1038/ismej.2016.70_coculture_prochlorococcus_mit9313_hot1a3_rnaseq',
  '10.1038/ismej.2016.82_coculture_24_hours_after_coculturing_mit1002_rnaseq',
  '10.1038/ismej.2016.82_coculture_48_hours_after_coculturing_mit1002_rnaseq',
  '10.1101/2025.11.24.690089_coculture_prochlorococcus_med4_hot1a3_rnaseq'
]
RETURN e.id AS exp, e.table_scope AS scope, e.reports_fold_change AS reports_fc,
       e.statistical_test AS stat_test, e.table_scope_detail AS detail

MATCH (e:Experiment)
WHERE e.organism_name CONTAINS 'Alteromonas'
RETURN e.medium AS medium, count(*) AS n,
       collect(DISTINCT split(e.id,'_')[0]) AS dois,
       collect(DISTINCT e.treatment_type) AS treatment_types
ORDER BY n DESC

MATCH (e:Experiment)
WHERE e.organism_name CONTAINS 'Alteromonas'
  AND (e.coculture_partner CONTAINS 'Prochlorococcus'
       OR e.id CONTAINS '690089' OR e.id CONTAINS 'ismeco' OR e.id CONTAINS 'mSystems')
RETURN e.id AS exp, e.omics_type AS omics, e.treatment AS treatment,
       e.control AS control, e.growth_phases AS growth_phases,
       e.time_point_labels AS tp_labels, e.time_point_hours AS tp_hours,
       e.time_point_growth_phases AS tp_phases
ORDER BY exp

MATCH (k:KeggTerm)
WHERE k.id IN ['kegg.pathway:ko02040','kegg.pathway:ko02030','ko02040','ko02030']
   OR k.name CONTAINS 'lagellar' OR k.name CONTAINS 'hemotaxis'
RETURN k.id AS id, k.name AS name, k.level AS level, k.level_kind AS level_kind
ORDER BY level
LIMIT 25

MATCH (k:KeggTerm) WHERE k.level IN [0,1] AND (k.name CONTAINS 'otilit' OR k.name CONTAINS 'ellular Proc' OR k.level=0)
RETURN 'KEGG' AS ont, k.id AS id, k.name AS name, k.level AS level, k.level_kind AS lk
UNION
MATCH (c:CogFunctionalCategory) WHERE c.code='N'
RETURN 'COG' AS ont, c.id AS id, c.name AS name, c.level AS level, '' AS lk
LIMIT 15
